Under the current release rules, keep `is.waiwai.dictation`. You can launch under the name **OpenRamble** while retaining that bundle identifier.

As owner, you can change the rule before launch. If you switch to `is.waiwai.openramble`, anyone who already granted Accessibility access to a prelaunch build will need to grant it again. First-time users will go through the usual permission setup.
